items.statement: A valid autonomous investigation enumerates and atom-maps distinct beta-scission hypotheses and reports candidate coverage and stopping.
items.expected: Candidate-level hypotheses, deduplication and stopping basis are documented.

items.statement: Advanced channels require minimum/TS frequency validation and a path connection test.
items.expected: Minima have zero and claimed TSs one imaginary frequency, with IRC or equivalent connection evidence.

items.statement: The source-supported favorable channel among investigated beta-scissions is acetophenone plus ethyl radical.
items.expected: A validated channel can be identified as acetophenone + ethyl radical.

items.statement: The source reports 9.07 kcal/mol for the acetophenone-forming channel.
items.expected: A validated result near 9.07 kcal/mol may support the source conclusion, with method dependence disclosed.
